name: Corsair
description: Corsair bands are independent groups of pirates and mercenaries who prey on merchant shipping throughout Vargr space and beyond, into the Zhodani Consulate and the Imperium.

raider.name: Raider
raider.description: You are part of the main attacking force in your band, specialising in boarding and looting ships.

pilot.name: Pilot
pilot.description: You are one of the pilots or navigators in your corsair band.

reaver.name: Reaver
reaver.description: You are part of the ship's crew and function as an engineer, gunner or other supporting role.

mishaps.1: Severely injured in action. Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: You are arrested but are able to pay a fine to earn your freedom. Lose one Benefit roll from this career and lose SOC −1.
mishaps.3: You are betrayed by a member of your band, ending your career as a Corsair. If you have an Ally or Contact in the band, they are now an Enemy; otherwise gain an Enemy.
mishaps.4: A job goes wrong and the pack looks for new leadership. Roll SOC 8+ to support the winning side. If you fail, you are forced to leave the band and gain a Rival.
mishaps.5: You make a mistake forcing your pack to flee from the local law enforcement. Lose SOC −1 and you are forced to leave your corsair band.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: You are arrested and hire a lawyer who gets the charges dropped. You lose one Benefit roll from this career but gain the lawyer as a Contact.
events.4: You are forced into hiding on a hostile world. Gain Survival 1.
events.5: You gain a Contact in the criminal underworld.
events.6: One of your raids is particularly successful. Gain a Benefit roll.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Vargr Life Events table.
events.8: Your time spent in the criminal underworld gives you one of Streetwise 1, Stealth 1, Melee (any) 1 or Gun Combat (any) 1.
events.9: You become involved in a territorial war with a rival corsair band. Roll Gun Combat (any) or Melee (any) 8+ to help defeat them. Gain SOC +1 if you succeed or roll on the Injury table if you fail.
events.10: Your leader uses poor judgement and your band suffers heavy losses. Roll SOC 10+ to become the new pack leader and gain an automatic promotion.
events.11: You support a pack member who becomes the new leader. Gain an Ally and DM+4 to your next Advancement roll.
events.12: Your raiding skills have become legendary. You gain an automatic promotion and SOC +1.
